speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; your recent visit to the state fair and the new symptom of darkening urine are significant. Given your history of Type 2 diabetes, I need to rule out diabetic ketoacidosis or severe infection, so please tell me if you have noticed any fruity odor to your breath or increased thirst. Additionally, can you describe the specific location and character of your abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and mild fever. I also have Abdominal pain, Nausea, Dark urine.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The darkening of your urine, combined with fatigue, fever, and abdominal pain after eating at a fair, strongly suggests a liver issue like acute hepatitis. Since you have diabetes, we must also rule out other complications. Have you experienced any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes, or any itching?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis
